name: Honey Pancake Anastasia Sukkhoi Rose de Marine
source:
Guard of Princess Emil, Pilot of the Vigil Dragoon.

A quietly devoted holstein, and a low ranking member of Duchy nobility. A childhood friend of Emil's who became her guard to preserve their close relationship, training herself into an incredibly talented pilot and sniper. Soft spoken and distant from most people, but holds a deep sense of protectiveness towards those close to her. Trying to become a more sociable person.

Sign: Taurus
Favourite Food: Honey pancakes.
Hobbies: Painting, Taking care of her car, Baking.
Likes: Emil, Driving, Peace and quiet.
Dislikes: The open sky.

[From [url=https://coquettedragoon.com/cast/]official website[/url]]
